about_the_game:
Equip yourself with the Classic Trinity stealth gear pack. This vintage outfit features the Hunter’s Array, allowing your steps to be quieter while running. The outfit also increases the effect of perception plants, giving long-lasting vision to hunt your enemies. This pack includes the Silent Sting, a pistol outfitted with a silencer suppressor enabling stealthy kills. Your enemies won’t hear you coming until it’s too late.

Included in the Croft Edition, the Season Pass, and The Price of Survival. Also available separately.
